text:
Sasha: FYI a customer hit a noticeable token delta today. Reprobed: client reconnect + resume during a streaming toolcall leads to provisional credits surviving alongside confirmed credits after resume.
Ara: Can you share the minimal trace? We need to see ordering around tombstone writes.
Sasha: Minimal trace (sanitized):
```
router: accept session S1
worker: toolcall chunk #n
router: connection lost S1
router: resume -> new session S2, resume_from=n+1
worker: emits EOF at chunk n (truncation)
ledger: provisional add S1 tokens 1..n
ledger: confirmed add S2 tokens n+1..m
```
Mike: Sounds like the router writes provisional capture before worker confirms EOF and tombstone'ing S1. Race between provisional write and tombstone/confirm.
Jordan: We previously called this "suffix-ownership race" but let's avoid recycled names. The concrete failure mode: provisional rows for S1 are never tombstoned when S2 takes over, so both provisional and confirmed appear in UI/billing.
Ara: Do we have an idempotency/id correlation in resume? If the client supplied the original session id we could detect overlap and dedupe.
Sasha: Most clients don't send that, and some mobile SDKs reconnect with new session ids by design.
Eva: UX impact: customers see a short-term spike and open tickets. If we show provisional vs settled in the console with explanatory hover text, support noise should drop.
Mike: Implementation options:
1) Router-side: delay writing provisional capture for trailing tokens until worker ack/tombstone (strong correctness, adds ~5-15ms extra on resume path).
2) Ledger-side: mark provisional rows with a resume_generation id and run reconciliation job that clears overlap within N seconds.
3) API/SDK: strongly encourage resume_idempotency token and expose a header to prefer in-placemate resumes.
Jordan: Tradeoffs: (1) is safest but touches hot path. (2) is async and complex but avoids added latency. (3) long runway.
Ara: Proposal: short-term = console flag + runbook + reconciliation job; medium-term = router patch to dependency-check provisional writes; long-term = SDK change + gateway validation.
Sasha: Also adding an observability metric: stream_resume_overlap_count{route, cause} and a dashboard alert when overlap_ratio > 0.5% for 1h.
LedgerBot: Note: created ticket LEDGER-5642 reconcile-provisional-overlaps
Mike: I'll add metric stub to proto and a lightweight handler to emit resume_generation on capture writes.
Jordan: I'll prototype the console tile showing provisional vs settled credits and a drilldown link to reconciliation traces.
Eva: I'll update support runbook and craft customer-facing wording for console tooltip.
Sasha: I'll draft an RFC for the router change with a microbenchmark. Meeting tomorrow 10am PT to align.
Mike: PR for proto today, ping when RFC ready.
Ara: Filing infra migration tickets for reconciliation job.
LedgerBot: CI: ledger/reconcile-job scheduled on infra-ci-5
Sasha: Thanks team. We'll iterate on telemetry first so we can measure scope before hitting the router hot path.
